description: Implement `Rewrite(plan_id?, operations: []FileMove|ImportRewrite) → RewriteResponse`. First call returns a `plan_id` plus a normalized operation log and no disk change. A second call with the `plan_id` and explicit `--apply` flag mutates the filesystem via `ts-morph` (which preserves formatting). The scenario never invokes git and never invokes `tsc`.

requirements.description: Implement Rewrite(plan_id?, operations: []FileMove|ImportRewrite) → RewriteResponse as a two-phase operation. Phase 1 (Plan): When called without a plan_id, generate and persist a plan_id, return a normalized and deduplicated operation log describing all intended mutations, and make zero filesystem changes. Phase 2 (Apply): When called with a valid plan_id and the explicit --apply flag, execute the planned mutations against the filesystem using ts-morph (which preserves code formatting). The scenario must never invoke git, tsc, or pnpm at any point. Apply is idempotent within a session but makes no atomicity guarantees on crash; operators recover via git externally.
requirements.title: Two-Step Rewrite: Plan Generation and Filesystem Apply

validation.notes: Test plan_id generation produces unique, stable identifiers across calls
Test that a Plan call returns a normalized operation log with deduplication of redundant moves
Test that a Plan call with FileMove operations returns zero filesystem mutations
Test that an Apply call without --apply flag is rejected with a typed error
Test that an Apply call with an unknown plan_id returns a typed NOT_FOUND error
Test ImportRewrite operation normalization (path resolution, canonical form)
Test that ts-morph formatting is preserved after an Apply (indentation, quote style unchanged)
TCG-REWRITE-PLAN: Call Rewrite without plan_id on a fixture project, assert no files are modified, assert plan_id is returned
TCG-REWRITE-APPLY: Call Rewrite with valid plan_id and --apply flag, assert filesystem reflects all planned operations
Verify that applying a FileMove correctly updates all import references in consuming files via ts-morph
Verify that git, tsc, and pnpm are never spawned during any Rewrite operation (process spy in CI)
An operator can plan a migration, review the operation log, and apply it in two distinct CLI invocations
Applied rewrites leave the project in a compilable state for a representative migration scenario

title: Two-Step Rewrite (Plan + Apply)
